item.text:
`get_relevant_context` now uses symbolic BM25 retrieval for topic-based queries: it builds weighted text fields from `(rdfs:label, 2.0)` and `(description, 1.0)` and calls `entity_index.search_records(...)`, then takes the top-k ranked results (no absolute threshold/floor; zero-overlap records are naturally excluded).  

If no topic is provided, it still takes the list-all path (`list_instances` via SPARQL), not ranked search.
